title: One of a Kind
start: Talk to Mr Mordaut in his office under the stairs in Varrock Museum.

items.t: Ghostspeak amulet or cramulet (unless the hard Morytania achievements have been completed)
875 coins to enter Brimhaven Dungeon (unless the hard Karamja achievements have been completed)

recommended.t: Ectophial and Remora's necklace for quick teleportation, as well as Dungeoneering cape, Hoardstalker ring or Big Book o' Piracy
5 metallic dragon trinkets for teleport to steel or iron dragons
Any method of protection from dragonfire
Law altar teleport for faster access to Entrana

kills.t: Must be able to survive attacks from a celestial dragon (level 127)

rewards.t: Access to the Dragontooth Island resource dungeon, containing celestial dragons, and the ability to receive celestial dragons as a Slayer assignment
Rotate all four mysterious statues during or after the quest to gain 10000 Skill XP in a skill of choice
The dragon-hunters (archer, mage, and warrior) and Echo of Jas can be faced in the Dominion Tower
If Ritual of the Mahjarrat has been completed, speak to the Submerged Statue on Entrana again to receive 25000 Skill XP in any non-elite skill (12,500 if elite)
The ability to translate murals in the Adamant dragon dungeon and on Mount Firewake with the Dragonkin Primer

steps.t: Talk to Mr. Mordaut in his office in the basement of Varrock Museum that is accessed behind the stairs. [Chat: 1 [One of a Kind] › Any › Accept]
Read the book Hannibus Hunted.
Talk to Mr. Mordaut. [Chat: Any › Any › 2 Bob the Cat? › Any]
p: The door that leads to basement with Mr. Mordaut, right behind the first flight of stairs

steps.t: Locate Bob the Cat with the catspeak amulet. An easy method to locate him is to hop worlds at the west Varrock anvils or searching nearby the Burthorpe lodestone. Most of the time he is inside Carwen Essencebinder Magical Runes Shop
Talk to Bob. [Chat: ? [One of a Kind] › 2 A human to look after? › 2 Maybe I'll check out this house...]
Travel to Unferth's house east of Burthorpe lodestone.

Talk to Unferth. [Chat: 1 I want to search your house for a hidden library. › 3 I'm not interested in your novels. › 1 I'm looking for the lost library of Robert the Strong. › 1 Is there any place that Bob the Cat seemed drawn to? › 2 That's all for now.]
p: The library of Robert the Strong

steps.t: Search the bookcase.
Investigate the fireplace.
Inspect the table.
Remove the carpet.
Enter the trapdoor.
Search the desk in the centre of the room.
Investigate the weapon rack to the north. [Chat: 1 Take some rust from the weapons.]
p: Hannibus is freed using the incantation Um nahi listic durooo-rah

steps.t: Use iron oxide on emerald to get Animate Rock scroll.
Read the Animate Rock scroll by the statue to the south.
Talk to Hannibus. [Chat: 1 Yes › 1 This is the Sixth Age. › Any › 1 What now? › 1 You could go home. › 4 We could look around this library! › 2 Let's take a look!]
Search the bookcase for the Dragonkin Primer to the east and Flight of the Dragonkin to the west.
Click the map in the south of the room to update location names
Head to the mysterious statue east of the Seers' Village bank.
Read the Animate Rock scroll by it. [Chat: 3 None of those - I'm human! › 1 I'll rotate you now. › 2 Goodbye.]
Repeat for the next 3 statues. Rotating all 4 statues gives access to 10,000 bonus experience in any skill. At least one is required to continue.

sub.t: North-west of the Karamja lodestone. [Chat: 1 Just tell me how to rotate you. › 2 Goodbye.]
North-west of the Ardougne lodestone. [Chat: 1 Just tell me how to rotate you. › 2 Goodbye.]
North of the Tower of Life (fairy ring DJP, Ardougne cloak for east of Kandarin Monastery, or Kandarin Monastery Teleport). [Chat: 1 Just tell me how to rotate you. › 2 Goodbye.]

p: Speaking to one of the mysterious statues.

steps.t: Travel to the north-west corner of Entrana.
Read the animate rock scroll by the submerged statue. [Chat: 3 Who was your other visitor? › 3 Do you know of a way to travel between worlds? › 4 Goodbye.]
Run to the green dragons in the south east corner of the Forinthry Dungeon. Hannibus will talk to you if you brought the Dragonkin Primer book. [Chat: 1 Yes]

sub.t: This dungeon is located in the Wilderness, so make sure that you are not opted in to PvP combat by talking to Vala.
A quick method is to use the Wilderness sword 2 teleport to the dungeon, or run east to the Wilderness Crater lodestone and run straight west to the dungeon entrance.
If you don't see Hannibus, exit the dungeon and re-enter it, then run towards green dragons, it will give you an option to continue the quest. Make sure you brought the Dragonkin Primer book.

p: Investigating the strange symbols with Hannibus

steps.t: Run close to the east wall of the room, near the lava. [Chat: 2 Let's investigate!]
Study the rock (on the ground east of the green dragon).
Travel to the iron/steel dragons in Brimhaven Dungeon. [Chat: 1 Yes]

sub.t: A quick method is using the Dungeoneering cape and selecting "Brimhaven metal dragon dungeon"
A slower method is walking west from the Karamja lodestone, entering the dungeon, and walking to the iron and steel dragons
If you don't get the question about 'One of a Kind' go back to the entrance of the room and walk slowly into the room again.

p: The Queen Black Dragon speaks through Hannibus

steps.t: Kill 3 iron dragons. [Chat: Any › Any]
Head to the west wall by the mysterious entrance to study the dragonkin writing.
Travel to the Grotworm Lair north-west of Port Sarim lodestone.

sub.t: Remora's necklace will take you directly outside of the portal.

steps.t: Enter the bottom level of the Grotworm Lair. You can use the shortcut to the south-east of the first floor to get there quickly. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Investigate the summoning portal. The portal is right next to the shortcut, a square hole in the wall gleaming green. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Talk with Hannibus. [Chat: 3 Your majesty - I have some questions. › 1 I seek means to travel between worlds. › 1 Tell me about the Dragonkin. › 1 Yes]
Travel to Dragontooth Island by talking to the ghost captain east of Port Phasmatys (south of those ships, in the small boat). [Chat: 1 Please take me to Dragontooth Island.]

sub.t: The fastest method is teleporting to Dragontooth Island directly, using the Dungeoneering cape teleport, or using the elder divination outfit to teleport to the "Radiant Wisp Colony".
A quick method to Port Phasmatys is heading to Port Sarim and taking a charter ship to Port Phasmatys (talk to Trader Stan south-east of the lodestone).
There are two ghost captains, you need to talk to the southern one who is standing next to a rowboat, not a ship.

p: Distracting a celestial dragon for Hannibus
Hannibus communicates with a celestial dragon

steps.t: Enter the mysterious entrance to the south.
Fight or tank a celestial dragon until Hannibus's bond reaches 100% (approximately 2 minutes).
Talk to Hannibus again.
Activate the Artefact north of Edgeville Monastery to meet with Hannibus in the King Black Dragon Lair. [Chat: 1 Yes - Meet with Hannibus. › 1 Continue]

sub.t: You will not enter a player-versus-player enabled area despite the warning.

p: Hannibus reunites with his old friend Shakorexis
The King reveals the entrance to Therragorn's residence

steps.t: Talk with the King Black Dragon. [Chat: 1 Sorry about killing you.]
Enter mysterious entrance.
Talk with Therragorn. [Chat: 1 Listen to Hannibus. › 1 Can you help Hannibus get home?]
Kill the 3 dragon-hunters.
p: Fighting off the hunters who came to kill Therragorn
You are hit by a fireball!

steps.t: Talk to Hannibus for a cutscene.
Kerapac will talk to you. [Chat: 3 Aaaaargh! A Dragonkin! › 2 Ask about companions. › 1 How's Hannibus? › 1 What's the favour? › 1 Okay, I'll help.]
Head into the far northern room. Kerapac will talk to you. [Chat: 2 Just tell me what to do.]
Harvest 25 dragonkin memories from the protoplasmic wisps and channel them into the cage.
Talk with Kerapac to fight Echo of Jas. [Chat: 1 I am ready!]
p: Watch out for the False Users!
Sharrigan proposes that Hannibus return to the Ilujanka homeworld with her

steps.t: Kill the Echo of Jas and then talk to it after you defeat it.
p: Siphoning Dragonkin memories from the wisps

steps.t: Kerapac will talk to you. [Chat: 4 What now? › 1 Yes. › 1 [Decide Hannibus's fate] › Any]
Quest complete!
